_source.title: 重新排序原理图图页
_source.remarks.text.0: 此处源原理图图页属性的数组需要通过 {@link DMT_Schematic.getAllSchematicPagesInfo} 或其它上游方法取得，完成数组排序后传入
_source.params.schematicUuid: 执行排序的图页所关联的原理图 UUID
_source.params.schematicPageItemsArray: 所有原理图图页属性的数组

title: Reorder schematic sheets
remarks.text.0: Here, the array of source schematic sheet properties needs to be obtained through {@link DMT_Schematic.getAllSchematicPagesInfo} or other upstream methods. After sorting the array, pass it in
params.schematicUuid: The UUID of the schematic associated with the sheets being sorted
params.schematicPageItemsArray: Array of all schematic sheet properties
returns: Sorting whether the operation is successful
